question: In August 2022, Uttarakhand Chief Minister named which cricketer as the brand ambassador of the state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rishabh **____**Pant**__ . 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prasoon Joshi is chosen by the Uttarakhand government to serve as its **brand ambassado**r.
 
• The government of Uttarakhand has chosen Prasoon Joshi, CEO and CCO of McCann World group India, to serve as the state's brand ambassador.
 
• CM names **Rishabh Pant as Uttarakhand's brand ambassador**.
 
• Pushkar Singh Dhami, the chief minister of Uttarakhand, recently named** Rishabh Pant as the state's brand ambassador.​**
 
• Rishabh Pant is 19 years old, young player from Delhi, he gained attention after his performance for India Under-19 at the 2016 World Cup.
 
• He opened the competition with a blistering 24-ball 75 against Nepal, the fastest half-century of the competition, and then finished it off with a century against Namibia.
 
• He is a dashing left-handed wicket-keeper batsman. India lost the championship match but gained some benefits, the biggest of which was the rise of Pant.​

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​Rishabh Pant:**

 
 
• The expertise that the IPL demands and the skill set that Rishabh Pant posses are absolutely in synchronization. 
 
• If ever the definition of an ideal T20 batsman would be written, Rishabh Pant would tick most of the aspects.
 
• He is a **ferocious hitter **of the cricket ball wide a wide array of shots and can clear the boundary ropes with ridiculous ease. 
 
• The scoops, the paddles, the flicks, you name it and this bloke has every shot in his repertoire.
 
 
 
• **Hardik Pandya:**
 
 
• **Hardik Himanshu Pandya (11 October 1993)** is an Indian cricketer who now serves as the** team's vice captain** in limited overs.
 
• Pandya is an **all-rounder** who has represented India in all three forms. He **bats right-handed and bowls right-arm fast-medium**.
 
 
 
• **Yuvraj Singh:**
 
 
• **Yuvraj Singh,** a former cricketer for India who competed in all formats of the game, was born on **December 12, 1981**.
 
• He is an all-rounder who bowled slow **left-arm orthodox balls and batted left-handed in the middle order.**
 
• He and former Indian captain Sourav Ganguly have both received seven Player of the Series honours in ODI cricket, which ranks as the** third-highest **total by an Indian.
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli:**
 
 
• **Virat Kohli**, a right-handed batsman for **Royal Challengers Bangalore in the IPL and for Delhi in domestic cricket in India**, was born on November 5, 1988.
 
• He is an **international cricketer for India** and a** former captain** of the Indian squad.
 
• One of the greatest batsmen of all time, Virat Kohli holds the record for most runs scored in **both T20 international matches and the IPL**.
 
 

c0:T
